name: PdfCraft
title: PdfCraft: free Adobe Acrobat alternative
hook: Adobe Acrobat charges you fifteen dollars a month to merge and organize your PDFs. This app does it for free.

features.intro: Every page, laid out like cards.
features.say: Rotate, delete, move or insert pages, then merge files or split them up.
Mark it up with highlights, notes and stamps.
Fill in forms, add a signature, or lock it with a password.

caption:
Adobe Acrobat charges $14.99/month. PdfCraft merges, organizes and marks up your PDFs for free 📄

✅ Rotate, delete, move and insert pages
✅ Merge files into one, or split them apart
✅ Highlights, notes and stamps
✅ Fill forms, sign and password-protect
✅ No account, no telemetry, no cloud, 100% free

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ It's still alpha: organizing, markup and forms work well today, but editing existing text isn't reliable yet.

Comment "PAGES" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
